ℹ️ About Maths Arcade

Maths Arcade is a free maths learning website for Singapore pupils in Primary 4 to 6 and Secondary 1 to 4. Each game practises one topic from school mathematics, such as fractions, decimals, percentage, time, speed, area and volume, angles, data, prime numbers, negative numbers and estimation, in short rounds with instant feedback.

How it helps pupils learn

  • Built around common mistakes. Wrong options are the mistakes pupils really make, and the feedback explains why an answer is wrong, not just that it is wrong.
  • Pitched at the right level. Every game has three levels (Easy, Medium and Hard, or Core, Stretch and Challenge), so pupils can start gently and move up.
  • Thinking first, hints on request. In two-step questions, Step 1 must be right before Step 2. Ask Qubi (bottom-left) gives hints one small step at a time and never gives away the answer.
  • Real contexts. Questions use Singapore settings such as MRT and bus journeys, shops and hawker prices.

For teachers and parents

  • Pupils can play as a guest (nothing is saved) or sign in with Google to save their scores and join the class leaderboard.
  • For signed-in pupils, teachers can see which topics each pupil has practised and where they need more help.
  • No adverts and nothing to buy. Questions or ideas? Open Ask Qubi → Send feedback.
